sections.voiceover: Archaeologists at Kayalıpınar in Turkey uncovered 131 cuneiform tablets from King Tudhaliya II's royal archive.
sections.visual_cue: Archaeological trench at Kayalıpınar excavation site, stable wide shot showing researchers working.

sections.voiceover: The tablets reveal a deadly epidemic during King Tudhaliya II's reign—including a nursing princess who died.
sections.visual_cue: Clay tablet with wedge-shaped cuneiform markings under even museum lighting, no camera movement.

sections.voiceover: 131 tablets revealed a lost royal tragedy. Preserved in clay for 3,400 years.
